takes.p: The National Science and Media Museum in Bradford holds the Ashton & Leakey Collection: sketches, prosthetics, glass eyes and fangs from Hammer make-up artists Roy Ashton and Phil Leakey, covering The Curse of Frankenstein (1957), Dracula (1958), The Mummy (1959) and The Gorgon (1964). Great British Life reports the museum is opening the collection up.
